types.name: Fenrir::RagdollDescriptionHandle
types.doc: A ragdoll description C# asked `Ragdoll.DescribeHumanoid` for, kept natively for the scene it was described in until `Ragdoll.Build` takes it or the scene ends. The id 0 is no description (C#'s `None`), what a refused description gives.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Which description: 0 for none. Ids are never reused while the extension lasts.
